registered: 2026-10-22, before the first GPU fold run it judges (pre-registration; a changed rule is a new file, a new review run and a new suite version)
subject: c21_v2_fold 1.0.0: the run-1 full-KD student T (/mnt/lexar/omni-campaign/distill/fullkd/run1/out/student) folded into the co2-fold-proxy profile (16 layers, width 512, 191,337,601 params), arm F-T, tie=head, global c20 chart. K3 form-E term, media units and the raw boundary / x0 head are NOT in this build (zero placeholders) and are not judged.
what_a_pass_means: the fold-init MECHANICS carry the source's knowledge into a v2-geometry checkpoint; it is not a candidate base and not a folding-progress claim beyond the per-component compression the receipt verifies

R0.rule: the child loads sha-verified through load_chimera_checkpoint, its config validates, every tensor is finite, its parameter count equals the profile's meta build (191,337,601), the c21 receipt names a fold method for every parameter (methods within c21.FOLD_METHODS), copy_methods == 0, four_x_rule == 'enforced', and every selection component (mixer head selection, FFN union coreset) has compression >= 4.0 computed from tensor shapes

R1.kind: behaviour gate for this mechanics validation (likelihood of real held text; NOT a token match against any teacher, NOT a pruning gate for any mechanism)
R1.data: omni-evidence-27b-v1 qwen_input_ids.safetensors held rows (split 1: rows 3, 7, 11, 15, 19, 23; never fitted, never used for lambda selection)
R1.metric: teacher-forced next-token NLL per token over each held row, ledger band masked
R1.rule: child token-weighted mean NLL < random-init control mean AND < embed-only control mean, AND the child is below BOTH controls on at least min_rows_below_both of the 6 held rows

R2.kind: behaviour gate, reader-graded (collapse-only bar, Cyril's artifact-tolerant read: loops, missing EOS and cap-rides never count against content)
R2.prompts: the 3 sealed smoke prompts (matrix_campaign_smoke_prompts_v1.json, prompt_set_sha256 2d7c7f7d5f3d759ace9572db17d5c945b8a727e9c2db18c936b027e3bdaa89d4) through the tokenizer's chat template with thinking off, plus a raw continuation of the first held_prefix_tokens tokens of each of the 6 held rows
R2.rule: PASS if at least 2 of the 9 child continuations are graded on-topic language (grade correct or partial) outside loop/termination artifacts; both controls are decoded and graded with the same grader and recorded
R2.grader: reader.collapse_only (first read by Claude, recorded as human:claude; Cyril's grade, when given, wins in v_effective_grade)
R2.machine_prescreen: distinct-token ratio, 4-gram loop flag, letter fraction: recorded, never a grade

controls.random_init: ChimeraOmniModel(co2-fold-proxy) with the module's own initialisation under torch.manual_seed(0)
controls.embed_only: the child with every block's mixer.out and ffn.down zeroed (the folded vocabulary and norms only)
controls.placement_control: not built: the ruling forbids placing an existing model, and building one for comparison would put it on disk

diagnostics_only: every fit / held relL2 of every ridge, the update scales and lambda ladder
period-end stream divergence (relL2, cos) of the v2 stream against alpha . h . C
the chart's retained energy, per source layer
the stream scale alpha and the input-side cosine of the tied rows
the source trunk's own held NLL (reference column)
the machine pre-screen of decoded text
verdict: R0 and R1 and R2 all pass = the proxy fold validates the mechanics; any fail is reported with its numbers and the rules stay as written
